definitions.full: H2056. valad וָלָד noun masculine offspring, child , only וָלָ֑ד לָהּ אֵין Gen 11:30 (J); si vera lectio = Arabic ; Ethiopic (with original ו ); — in 2Sam 6:23 , where some editions have ולד Kt, יָ֑לֶד Qr, Baer and van d. H give יָ֑לֶד Kt.
